limits: The file requirement recognizer is intentionally restricted; it is not a general natural-language requirement extractor.
Only two or three complete root-level .txt exact-content lines produce a complete multi-requirement inventory.
The local controlled Provider does not establish real Provider quality or task understanding.
CDP-driven Renderer checks do not constitute physical input or accessibility-device acceptance.
A passed file check is evidence about the checked version and time; later changes require a new check.
No global transaction exists across Durable Event, ExecutionLog, Session transcript, and Run checkpoint; inconsistency remains conservatively unknown per S2C-D.
